title: Delete boxes for emails no longer visible
creator: eparker32
content: Usually when I open mail, there are boxes next to each email that I can click to delete. content: My calnedar is frozen. On the left side is the month of October 2026. I click on the arrow to move to Novemebr or September nothing happens. title: Alert from added account: failure due to backend error
creator: juriyronzhin
content: Yandex email account. Messages are constantly being received: “Alert from account [redacted]@yandex.ru: UID fetch message 5 uid 122: failure due to backend error”. The numbers are always different. Emails are being received and sent. The server settings — the ones recommended by Yandex — are configured correctly. But these notifications appear almost every second. What is the problem?
